lines.en: Leo, our client said she would be at the office by six, but it is already seven and nobody has heard from her.
lines.pt: Leo, nossa cliente disse que estaria no escritório às seis, mas já são sete e ninguém teve notícias dela.

lines.en: Yesterday she promised that she would bring the contract herself, and I thought she would arrive early.
lines.pt: Ontem ela prometeu que traria o contrato pessoalmente, e achei que chegaria cedo.

lines.en: Exactly. When we spoke last week, she told me the meeting would take an hour, so I booked the small room.
lines.pt: Exato. Quando falamos semana passada, ela me disse que a reunião levaria uma hora, então reservei a sala pequena.

lines.en: I knew the room would be too small. Our manager said we would need space for ten people, remember?
lines.pt: Eu sabia que a sala seria pequena. Nosso gerente disse que precisaríamos de espaço para dez pessoas, lembra?

lines.en: He also said the budget would be approved by Friday, but nobody has confirmed it, which worries me.
lines.pt: Ele também disse que o orçamento seria aprovado até sexta, mas ninguém confirmou, o que me preocupa.

lines.en: Maybe that is why she is late. I assumed she would call if there was a problem, but my phone is silent.
lines.pt: Talvez seja por isso que ela está atrasada. Presumi que ligaria se houvesse um problema, mas meu celular está mudo.

lines.en: Her assistant promised that someone would phone us before five, and I believed him. I guess I was too optimistic.
lines.pt: A assistente dela prometeu que alguém nos ligaria antes das cinco, e eu acreditei. Acho que fui otimista demais.

lines.en: Do not blame yourself. When I joined, they told me everything would be organised, and look at us now.
lines.pt: Não se culpe. Quando entrei, me disseram que tudo seria organizado, e olhe para nós agora.

lines.en: Let me send her one more email and say we would wait until half past seven, and no longer.
lines.pt: Deixe-me mandar mais um e-mail e dizer que esperaríamos até as sete e meia, e nem um minuto mais.

lines.en: Good idea. I will also tell the security guard that we would be here until eight.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. Também vou avisar o segurança de que ficaríamos aqui até as oito.

lines.en: Perfect. If she still does not show up, I will tell the manager she promised to come, so he can decide.
lines.pt: Perfeito. Se ela ainda não aparecer, direi ao gerente que ela prometeu vir, para ele decidir.

facts.label: She said she would be there by six
facts.sub: will vira would no relato · thought she would · promised that she would

facts.label: will → would
facts.sub: No discurso indireto no passado, will vira would: “I will come” → She said she would come. O verbo seguinte fica no infinitivo, sem to.

facts.label: thought… would
facts.sub: Would também mostra o que esperávamos que acontecesse: I thought she would arrive early. Depois de thought, knew, expected e promised use would.

items.s: She said she will be there means the same as She said she would be there in indirect speech.
items.why: In the past we use would.

items.s: Would shows a past view of the future.
She promised that she would bring the contract is correct.

pages.title: She said she would be there by six · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a warm evening in Austin. The office is almost empty. Gabe and Leo sit near the big window. A folder waits on the table. The clock on the wall says seven. They are still waiting for an important client.

“Leo, our client said she would be at the office by six, but it is already seven and nobody has heard from her.” says Gabe. “Yesterday she promised that she would bring the contract herself, and I thought she would arrive early.” says Leo. “Exactly. When we spoke last week, she told me the meeting would take an hour, so I booked the small room.” says Gabe.
